title: The newform of weight 2 and level 11
abstract: The first newform of weight 2 with trivial character, the one attached to the elliptic curves of conductor 11, is constructed and characterised completely, in one statement that uses only Mathlib definitions. f(z) = η(z)²η(11z)² = q∏(1 − qⁿ)²(1 − q¹¹ⁿ)² (LMFDB 11.2.a.a) is a cusp form of weight 2 for Γ₀(11) with integer coefficients a(n), a(1) = 1, a(2) = −2. It spans the cusp forms of weight 2 for Γ₀(11); a modular form of that weight and level agreeing with it up to q² (the Sturm bound) equals it; and its coefficients satisfy the Hecke relations a(m)a(n) = ∑_{d | (m,n), 11 ∤ d} d·a(mn/d²), hence multiplicativity and the prime-power recursions. Method: (1) η² has a multiplier on SL(2,ℤ), exp(2πiψ(γ)/12), with ψ an explicit function of the entries modulo 12, proved from the S and T laws and a finite check; (2) for γ in Γ₀(11) the multipliers of η²(z) and η²(11z) cancel because 11 ≡ −1 (mod 12); (3) vanishing at the cusps follows from f¹² = Δ(z)Δ(11z); (4) a cusp form of weight 2 and level 11 with a₁ = 0 vanishes, because its norm to level one has weight 24 and order at least 3 at ∞; (5) the Hecke operators preserve the one-dimensional space, and the coefficient formula gives the relations; (6) integrality comes from the pentagonal number theorem.
